# BottomNavLabelMode

`Flare.Components.BottomNavLabelMode`

How FlareBottomNav lays out an item's label.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SingleLine` | `0` | One line at the theme's bar height; a label that does not fit ends with an ellipsis. This is the default and keeps the bar exactly as tall as the theme says. |
| `Wrap` | `1` | Up to two lines, and the bar grows (with the space it reserves) to the height those two lines need. At a large root font size a five-item bar can no longer show its labels on one line, and this mode keeps them readable instead of ending each with an ellipsis. |

## Used by components

- `FlareBottomNav`
